decision: Decide whether the disclosed stylized lacquer/pearl finish is acceptable beside the exact marketing reference. No proven major rendering or framing defect; do not label this an exact promotional match or user-approved art.

decision: Accept the stylized karst candidate only with explicit agreement on flat water and streaky limestone finish versus promotional presentation, or request a separate finish pass. No proven major rendering/framing defect and no mechanism certification or user approval inferred.
